teaser: "Stay for one more song," someone says, hand on your sleeve, and your eyes have slid past them toward the door. You are a 5, life path of the restless mover, crossed with ENFP, the type that falls for a room before it has finished walking in. The pairing is almost too neat: both want motion, both want possibility, and the pull toward the next thing can arrive before the current thing has finished happening. At the reception you are three conversations deep before the first course, already composing the story of the night while it is still half-lived.
